_doc: Hand-curated manuals. Every licence was read on the document itself on 2026-10-21 (field 'evidence'). kind: epub = the project's own EPUB as published; html1 = one-page HTML edition, split into chapters at the given heading level. NC/ND licences are never listed.

items.d: The official Python documentation: tutorial, language reference, standard library, how-tos and FAQ.
items.evidence: docs.python.org 'History and License': PSF License Agreement covers the software and its documentation; examples under Zero-Clause BSD

items.d: La documentazione ufficiale di Python (tradotta in parte in italiano): tutorial, riferimento del linguaggio, libreria standard, guide e FAQ.
items.evidence: same PSF licence; translation by the python-docs translation team, published by docs.python.org

items.d: La documentation officielle de Python en français : tutoriel, référence du langage, bibliothèque standard, guides et FAQ.
items.evidence: same PSF licence; python-docs-fr translation, published by docs.python.org

items.d: La documentación oficial de Python en español: tutorial, referencia del lenguaje, biblioteca estándar, guías y preguntas frecuentes.
items.evidence: same PSF licence; python-docs-es translation, published by docs.python.org
